releaseNotes:
• Native Android Permissions: Camera, Microphone, and Location now invoke official native Android permission dialogs (e.g. voice notes in WhatsApp, camera in Instagram)
• Universal File & Media Attachments: Full support for <input type="file"> with native Android File Picker, Gallery, Documents, and Camera ('Take photo') capture
• Floating Browser & Popup OAuth Integration: All attachments and permissions seamlessly work across all floating web apps, secondary popups, and the browser
• WebView Deadlock Prevention: Safe fallback unblocks file inputs immediately if picker is dismissed or cancelled
